title: A flow mapping replaced by another mapping stays a flow mapping
notes: The replaced value keeps its style when that style can hold the new value (docs/edit-semantics.md, The value keeps its style); a flow mapping holds any mapping with plain string keys. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend rewrote the replaced flow mapping as a block mapping; the pure backend kept the flow style.
